title: ValidatePathRequest
description: Request body for validatePathAtTime. Evaluates a caller-supplied ordered relation path at a query time under a profile and policy, returning path- and step-level admissibility.

relationIds.description: The ordered relation identifiers forming the path to validate.

profileVersion.description: Optional pin to an exact grounding-profile version; supplied, the implementation MUST execute that version or fail rather than substitute another.

policyVersion.description: Optional pin to an exact admission-policy version, with the same contract as `profileVersion`.
